host_generated_graphics.scope: Generated graphics only: zoom/flip/priority, rowscroll, partial tiles, dense and sparse text plans, conflicting font-cache tiles with copied indices, text allocation failure retaining row fallback, decoded-cache conflict/capacity fallback, pool wrap, exact ordered sprite reservation with warm-hit preservation and pre-reset pin safety, virtual-tag allocation failure without cache side effects and retry, prepared sprite snapshot, stable/mode/target/UI-reset output and guards. No guest CPU or device execution model. MXU uses C fallback on host.

host_pcm.environment: actual C YM2610 and PCM producer on host; firmware services unreachable stubs; no CPU or device simulation

limitations: Measured real-time windows are not deterministic replays or a guarantee for every stage.
First encounters with new ROM pages and sprite decodes can still stall; cold measurements are kept separately.
Capacity/active tile-cache conflicts correctly fall back to the original renderer.
Earlier long-key attempts that reached demonstration/continue screens are excluded from steady player-action results.
The 0.1.2 Neo Geo release BDA is separate; this task does not publish a new GitHub release.
No game ZIP, BIOS, converted ROM resources or RAM dump is distributed.
